# `btrim`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
btrim(str)
```

Removes the leading and trailing space characters from `str`.

btrim(str, trimStr) - Remove the leading and trailing `trimStr` characters from `str`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT btrim('    SparkSQL   ');
```

Result:

```text
SparkSQL
```

```sql
SELECT btrim(encode('    SparkSQL   ', 'utf-8'));
```

Result:

```text
SparkSQL
```

```sql
SELECT btrim('SSparkSQLS', 'SL');
```

Result:

```text
parkSQ
```

```sql
SELECT btrim(encode('SSparkSQLS', 'utf-8'), encode('SL', 'utf-8'));
```

Result:

```text
parkSQ
```
